description:
Follow-up to migrate-remaining-adapters-to-csv-resolver-pipeline (completed
2026-04-25). That work converted DuckDB, ClickHouse, StarRocks, Databend,
Firebolt, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, Spark, Velox, and LakeSail to
resolve_csv_dialect(). The adversarial review of that work flagged that the
TODO scope explicitly excluded several adapters that still drive CSV/TBL
load options through is_tpc_format() / get_delimiter_for_file(). Those
adapters need the same migration so the codebase converges on one CSV
dialect contract.

Current evidence from the live codebase (verified 2026-04-26):

- benchbox/platforms/snowflake.py:855 — _get_file_format_for_table() picks
  BENCHBOX_TBL_FORMAT vs BENCHBOX_CSV_FORMAT via is_tpc_format(first_file).
  Manifest-annotated .csv carrying TPC dialect metadata silently falls into
  the CSV format branch.
- benchbox/platforms/fabric_warehouse.py:945,950,1024 — branches on
  is_tpc_format(data_file) to pick field_terminator and reads
  get_delimiter_for_file(data_file) for COPY INTO statements.
- benchbox/platforms/datafusion.py:845 — _detect_csv_format() falls back
  to get_delimiter_for_file(file_paths[0]).
- benchbox/platforms/azure_synapse.py:541,610 — uses
  get_delimiter_for_file(first_file) for COPY INTO field_terminator and
  direct INSERT delimiter.
- benchbox/platforms/dataframe/{modin,cudf,pandas,pyspark,dask,lakesail}_df.py
  — use is_tpc_format(path) to gate has_trailing_delimiter() probing in
  DataFrame loaders. Same trailing-delimiter behaviour change addressed in
  DuckDB needs to be propagated through these read paths. (Note: the
  predecessor TODO migrated the SQL lakesail.py platform; lakesail_df.py
  and dask_df.py were not included and still use is_tpc_format.)
- benchbox/platforms/base/utils.py:45 — detect_file_format() uses
  is_tpc_format() to pick a default delimiter when no metadata is supplied.
  This is a shared utility — verify whether it should be migrated or
  documented as the legitimate "no-context" fallback.

preserves.behavior: DataSourceResolver remains the single source of table/file resolution; do not reimplement manifest walking inside adapters.
Dataframe adapter trailing-delimiter probing preserves the `null_marker is not None` gate so non-TPC CSVs do not pay the extra disk read.
Snowflake named file format objects (BENCHBOX_TBL_FORMAT, BENCHBOX_CSV_FORMAT) still load TPC and CSV data with their existing column/null/date semantics.
null_marker=None remains semantically distinct from a missing null marker; adapters must not replace explicit None with a default string.
resolve_csv_dialect() precedence remains manifest table_metadata first, then real benchmark csv_* attributes, then file-extension fallback with logging.
